_purpose: CLI-reference doc URLs flagged by user 2026-04-19 for the Redis cache strategy work in plan Phase C.7. Pinned in manifest.yaml so make graphql-web tracks drift; this sidecar preserves the original {url: [title, html_url]} mapping for cache-key shape design.
_redis_cache_design_notes: Cache key candidate: sha1(url) — 40 hex chars, fits Redis token format
Cache value: {title, html_url, sha256, snapshot_path, last_seen, ttl_until}
TTL: 24h or last_seen + 24h, whichever is later
Invalidation: make graphql-web bumps last_seen and re-publishes; Redis SET on every successful fetch
Per WA Managing Dependency Threats: cache MUST NOT bypass the sha256 drift check — Redis is a read-through, hash check is authoritative
